# ABC-1001 — Cancel keeps stock reserved



Status: Jira: QA · Inferred: fix_ready

## Ticket summary

### What is the problem?

- Cancel an order: stock stays reserved. [`jira:ABC-1001`]

### What is the current root cause, and how certain is it? (confirmed)

- Cancel never releases the reservation. [[rc00000002](all-recorded.md#i-rc00000002)]

### What changed?

- ABC-1001 release stock on cancel; reached qa; PR #7 merged [`commit:a1b2c3d`, `pr:7`]

## Brief

_Generated 2026-09-01 12:00 · Jira: QA · Inferred: fix_ready_

### Root cause (Confirmed)

Cancel never releases the reservation.[^1]

### Helpful findings

- Reservation rows stay active after cancel.[^2]
- The nightly job skips cancelled orders.[^3]
- **Ruled out:** The nightly job alone.[^3]

### How it works today

1. Cancel sets the status and returns.[^4]

### Proposed fix

- Release the reservation before saving the cancel.[^5]

### Fixes made _(from git and PRs)_

- a1b2c3d ABC-1001 release stock on cancel (2026-09-01)[^6]
- PR #7 feature/ABC-1001-cancel → qa[^7]
- Reached: Merged to qa (PR #7, 2026-09-01)

The commit releases stock on cancel.[^6][^7]

### How it works after the fix

1. Cancel releases the reservation, then sets the status.[^8]

**Verified:** The cancel tests pass.[^9]

### Possible cons

- **Recorded:** Partial cancels release the full quantity.[^10]
- **Suggested:** Concurrent cancels may release twice.[^5]
